title: Keep newer settings edits after a pending save
summary: A form sends version A while the user types version B. Finishing A must not claim that B was saved. Track edits across the request, keep newer changes editable, and close the group only when the saved version still matches.
validation_docs: Issue #32421. Documentation and final test results belong to settings/validation.md. Depict behavior and architecture, not test counts.
